description: A bare tabletop is in front of you, with a small open plastic cup off to the left and a mint-green, glittery slime with foam beads held at the center. The left hand and right hand hold the slime as a two-hand object, stretching it outward into a thin band, then folding it back in and squeezing inward; the right hand pinches and tucks a corner while the left hand presses and pulls, repeating the stretch-and-fold motion to knead it.
